analysis_limits: Static AST analysis only; donor code is never imported.
Attributes imported from a local module are linked to that module, not proven to exist.
direct_tests are import links, not a claim of behavioral coverage.
Fixture lists include conftest/fixture directories; dynamic fixtures and runtime registration require review.
Inferred exports and dynamic imports are not proof of a complete graph.
Implicit parent package initialization, getattr/plugin discovery and runtime mutations are not modeled.

aiogram.dispatcher.router.reason: Retain traversal/order; replace Telegram observer registry with explicit Mattermost events and remove Telegram update type enumeration.

aiogram.dispatcher.event.bases.reason: Retain sentinels and SkipHandler/CancelHandler; bind middleware event type to native Event instead of TelegramObject.

aiogram.dispatcher.event.event.reason: Generic lifecycle observer; namespace rewrite only.

aiogram.dispatcher.event.handler.reason: Retain signature DI and filters; import only the selected BaseHandler, update warning namespace; no aggregate Telegram handlers.

aiogram.dispatcher.event.telegram.reason: Retain filter/middleware orchestration and stop/skip behavior; rename observer, bind native Event, remove Telegram-only wording and validation.

aiogram.dispatcher.flags.reason: Retain decorator flags; rename aiogram_flag storage and remove Telegram chat_action typing protocol.

aiogram.dispatcher.middlewares.base.reason: Use native Event in middleware protocol; retain algorithm/interface.

aiogram.dispatcher.middlewares.manager.reason: Use native Event in annotations; retain middleware order and wrapping.

aiogram.filters.base.reason: Generic filter and inversion protocol; namespace rewrite only.

aiogram.filters.logic.reason: Generic AND/OR/NOT filter composition; namespace rewrite only.

aiogram.handlers.base.reason: Bind class-based handler to native Event/Bot; remove TelegramObject bound.

aiogram.fsm.state.reason: Retain state/group naming and matching; accept native Event without TelegramObject.

aiogram.fsm.context.reason: Generic storage facade; namespace rewrite only after storage contract adaptation.

aiogram.fsm.storage.base.reason: Replace integer Telegram keys with explicit server/bot/channel/user/thread string identifiers; preserve storage operations and isolation abstraction.

aiogram.fsm.storage.memory.reason: Retain memory storage and locks with native keys and native DataNotDictLikeError; verify cancellation and reuse.

aiogram.fsm.strategy.reason: Define explicit Mattermost channel/user/thread strategies with string IDs; no integer surrogate IDs.

aiogram.utils.magic_filter.reason: Portable magic-filter as_ extension; no platform imports.

aiogram.utils.warnings.reason: Rename AiogramWarning base to MattergramWarning; preserve warning hierarchy.

aiogram.dispatcher.dispatcher.reason: Telegram polling/update/session orchestration is replaced by native REST/WS/HTTP lifecycle, not namespace copied.

aiogram.reason: Root exports import Telegram Bot/methods/types. Write an explicit native public facade.

aiogram.filters.reason: Aggregate filter exports pull in Telegram methods/types. Export only selected filters.

aiogram.handlers.reason: Aggregate handler exports include Telegram-only events. Export selected BaseHandler only.

aiogram.types.reason: Full generated Telegram model graph is outside the port; create native Mattermost models.

aiogram.exceptions.reason: Telegram transport errors are replaced by native status/payload exceptions; no copied transport semantics.
